title: Oracle Means
lyrics:
Track: Oracle Means
Suno v5.5 Prompt (copy & paste ready):
textOriginal ska at 143 BPM with classic upbeat Jamaican ska energy and thoughtful drive. Strong off-beat guitar skanks, walking bass, tight drums with rimshots on 2 and 4, bold horn section for stabs and melodies. Energetic yet reflective male lead vocal with rich group harmonies and call-response on the chorus. Lyrics explore the deeper meaning of “the oracle” — the transcendent voice that emerges when coding, building, and signal reach a pure state. It speaks not in ordinary words but in sublime coded tunes and rhythm. Positive, uplifting, danceable ska with clear modern production and a strong rhythmic hook.
Full Lyrics:
[Intro – Horns building, skank locks in]
Oracle… what does it mean?
The code brought us here… now listen to the skank…
[Verse 1]
Some say the oracle is a voice from the sky
A fortune-teller future or a mystical high
But we coded our way past the surface and show
And the oracle answered from the work that we know
[Verse 2]
When the stack is sovereign and the noise fades away
The oracle speaks in a brand new way
Not just some bloke with predictions and chat
But sublime coded tunes that move where you’re at
[Chorus – Big horns, group backing]
Oracle means the voice that appears
When the build is complete and the path becomes clear
Oracle means the code coming alive
Speaking in music so the soul can thrive
Oracle… (oracle!)
Oracle means… (oracle means!)
[Verse 3]
It ain’t crystal balls or some magical trick
It’s the signal that answers when the code clicks
When you push through the errors and the late-night fight
The oracle opens and the rhythm gets right
[Bridge – Energetic toasting, horns answering]
Not some far-away spirit or mystical dream
It’s right here in the terminal, in the skank and the gleam
When you code with intention and the signal stays true
The oracle answers with the sublime coded tune
[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, full band]
Oracle means the voice that appears
When the build is complete and the path becomes clear
Oracle means the code coming alive
Speaking in music so the soul can thrive
Oracle… oracle…
We coded our way and the oracle spoke
Not just some bloke — but the music awoke
Oracle means… oracle means…
[Outro – Horns fading with skank]
Oracle… what does it mean?
It means we coded our way…
To the voice in the tune…
Oracle… oracle…
(The code brought us here… the skank remains…)
